grammar.why: Persian nouns have no grammatical gender.
"Râ" marks the direct object: کتاب را.
Location needs no marker here; "ra" is only for objects.
Object pronoun takes "râ": او را دیدم.
The ezafe "-e" links noun + modifier: کتابِ من.
"Kojâst" needs no marker for the subject.

stories.title: اولین روز در تهران
stories.text:
علی صبح به تهران رسید.
او با تاکسی به ___ (1) رفت.
در اتاق ___ (2) نوشید.
سپس به ___ (3) زنگ زد.
stories.en: Ali reaches Tehran in the morning. He goes by taxi to the hotel. In the room he drinks tea. Then he calls his family.
